VAR score_286 = 0
VAR celebrated_286 = false
TEXT timer_hud_286 "剩余 15 秒"
TEXT score_text_286 "得分 0"
SIGNAL ecv3_286_timer_start

ON ecv3_286_timer_start "并行倒计时"
    LOOP timer_286 > 0
        WAIT 1000
        VAR timer_286 - 1
        TEXT_SET timer_hud_286 "剩余 {timer_286} 秒"

ON ecv3_286_correct "条件庆祝反馈"
    VAR score_286 + 5
    TEXT_SET score_text_286 "得分 {score_286}"
    IF score_286 >= 15
        IF celebrated_286 == false
            SE "掌声" vol=0.85
            FIREWORK count=24 life=900 x=280 y=220
            VAR celebrated_286 = true
